The impact of the described data breach is significant due to the sensitive nature of the compromised data. The breach exposed patient names, health insurance details, medical histories, and treatment information. This combination of personally identifiable information (PII) and protected health information (PHI) creates a high risk for both identity theft and insurance fraud. With 200,000 individuals affected, the potential for widespread financial harm and privacy violations is substantial.
